title: YOUDrive: Driving Style as a Composable Direction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.14802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end driving policies can achieve strong task performance while offering limited control over their driving style. Driving style describes how a vehicle accelerates, brakes, and maintains distance. Policies trained without explicit preference conditioning lack a direct mechanism for adjusting these behaviors at inference. We propose YOUDrive, a vision--language--action planner for continuous and composable driving-style control. Each teacher's behavior is distilled into a task vector, a learned parameter update that induces a style direction in the planner's representation. These directions can be scaled and combined at inference without retraining the backbone. Conditioned on these directions, a flow-matching decoder models a multimodal trajectory distribution and generates kinematically feasible motion alternatives. We introduce the Style Alignment Score (SAS) to describe human-referenced kinematic behavior after safety and tas

translated_title: YOUDrive：将驾驶风格作为端到端自动驾驶的可组合方向
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.14802v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：端到端驾驶策略虽然能够实现出色的任务性能，但对其驾驶风格的控制却十分有限。驾驶风格描述的是车辆如何加速、制动和保持车距。在没有显式偏好条件约束下训练的策略，缺乏在推理阶段直接调整这些行为的机制。我们提出了YOUDrive，一个用于连续且可组合驾驶风格控制的视觉-语言-动作规划器。每位教师（teacher）的行为被蒸馏成一个任务向量，即一种学习到的参数更新，它在规划器的表示空间中诱导出一个风格方向。这些方向可以在推理阶段进行缩放和组合，而无需重新训练主干网络。在这些方向的条件下，流匹配解码器对多模态轨迹分布进行建模，并生成运动学上可行的运动备选方案。我们引入了风格对齐分数，用于描述在安全和任务约束下参照人类的运动学行为表现。
tldr: YOUDrive提出了一种视觉-语言-动作规划器，通过将教师驾驶行为蒸馏为可缩放、可组合的风格方向，无需重新训练即可在推理阶段对端到端自动驾驶策略的驾驶风格进行连续精细控制。
